tickerText: [TENNIS] Sara Errani and Jasmine Paolini became the first doubles team into the WTA Finals semis after a three-set win in Indian Wells, while Group 2 singles pairs Sabalenka–Svitolina and Andreeva–Muchova play Wednesday as the Nitto ATP Finals draw in Turin lands Thursday • [SQUASH] The PSA Pittsburgh Open Silver event opened its 32-man draw on November 11 while Shanghai readies the season-ending China Open Gold from November 17 with Mostafa Asal, Amina Orfi and $279,000 on the line • [BADMINTON] An Se-young took an 11th title of 2026 at the YEOSU VICTOR Korea Open and Victor Lai became Canada's first men's champion at the Super 500 stop in Yeosu • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Worlds wrapped in Texas with John Lucian Goins men's singles gold, Anna Leigh Waters sweeping three titles and 15-year-old Tama Shimabukuro pairing JW Johnson for a five-game men's doubles comeback • [TABLE TENNIS] Qualifying for WTT Contender Istanbul runs through November 11 at Ata Sporları Merkezi ahead of a $100,000 main draw headlined by Anders Lind, Honoka Hashimoto and a deep Japanese women's field

newsItems.title: Italians Advance
newsItems.excerpt: Sara Errani and Jasmine Paolini rallied for a 3-6, 6-2, 10-7 win on Tuesday to become the first team into the 2026 WTA Finals doubles semifinals in Indian Wells.

newsItems.title: Shanghai Gold Next
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA's final Gold event of 2026 brings 48 players to Shanghai November 17–22, with defending champion Amina Orfi and world No. 1 Mostafa Asal headlining the draws.

newsItems.title: Goins Takes Worlds
newsItems.excerpt: John Lucian Goins beat Jack Sock 11-5, 12-10 for his first PPA major singles title as Anna Leigh Waters completed another Triple Crown at the Opendoor Worlds in Texas.

newsItems.title: Istanbul Draw Opens
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Contender Istanbul qualifying is underway ahead of the November 12 main draw, where Tom Jarvis, Anders Lind and Honoka Hashimoto chase ranking points at Ata Sporları Merkezi.
